vehicles.name: Ship 42
vehicles.display_status: Retired for public display (display site not stated)
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 3×, SF 2×, fully stacked — matches confirmed counts.
vehicles.latest_note: Caught at the Pad 2 tower on Flight 15 (first Starship upper-stage catch, T+22:32:34 → 15 Nov 2026, 8:20 am AEDT). On 15 Nov 2026 Elon Musk said it could be reflown after refurbishment; on 18 Nov 2026 he said it will be retired for public display (site not stated).

source.title: Space.com — Musk: retire first caught Starship upper stage for display

extra_sources.title: SpaceX on X — Mechazilla catches Starship

vehicles.name: Ship 43
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 0, SF 0, stacked (stale — cryo now confirmed ×2).
vehicles.latest_note: Expected with Booster 23 for Flight 16 (expected_unofficial). No official Flight 16 date. The unofficial NET 10 Dec 2026 LC-39A target is now in doubt (NASASpaceflight 19 Nov: Cape debut removed from a “high profile missions” slide; possible Starbase repeat for F16).

source.title: NASASpaceflight on X — Cape debut slide change

vehicles.name: Ship 44
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 0 (stale — at least 3× cryo at Massey's Nov 2026).
vehicles.latest_note: Cryogenic campaign at Massey's 20–23 Nov 2026 (at least 3 tests; do not record 4 without consensus). Rolled back to production with Booster 24 on 23–24 Nov UTC. Unofficial Flight 17 candidate.

source.title: Felix Schlang on X — S-44 cryo / rollback
